subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) At times they were very rude to him. (b) Tarek was a very bright student and he was also helpful to others. (c) Tarek took it to heart but did not get very upset. (d) Seeing this, some other brighter students of the class also began to help the weaker students. (e) But he was not received warmly. (f) Tarek’s class teacher, Mr. Rahman, introduced Tarek to the class. (g) They did not want to mix with him, to play with him or even talk to him. (h) Some of the students laugh at him from the very beginning.
guide_solution: f → e → h → a → g → c → b → d Tarek’s class teacher, Mr. Rahman, introduced Tarek to the class. But he was not received warmly. Some of the students laugh at him from the very beginning. At times they were very rude to him. They did not want to mix with him, to play with him or even talk to him. Tarek took it to heart but did not get very upset. Tarek was a very bright student and he was also helpful to others. Seeing this, some other brighter students of the class also began to help the weaker students.
